caption: The drawing shows a rectangular textile with multiple sections, each displaying distinct patterns and motifs. The textile's background alternates between reddish-orange, brown, and deep blue shades. The patterns primarily consist of white floral designs, including leaves, flowers, and vines, occupying most of the sections. One section near the bottom right corner features a simple white geometric building with a triangular pediment, central door, multiple small windows, and a cupola on the roof, set against an orange background. The right edge of the textile has visible blue and orange fringe. A thin border along the bottom and right sides contains a repeating white floral motif on a dark background. The drawing is signed "Alois E. Unkel" in small print near the bottom right of the image.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
